description: Someone is threatening to share my private photos with my family and friends unless I pay them money. They contacted me through WhatsApp.
میرے سابق شوہر نے میری تصاویر لیکر مجھے دھمکی دی ہے کہ اگر میں طلاق کے مقدمے سے پیچھے نہ ہٹی تو وہ یہ تصاویر سوشل میڈیا پر ڈال دے گا۔

My ex-partner posted intimate photos of me on a website without my permission. These are real photos taken with my consent when we were together but I never agreed to share them publicly.
کسی نے میری تصویر کو میری اجازت کے بغیر ایک فحش ویب سائٹ پر ڈال دیا۔ میں نہیں جانتی یہ کس نے کیا لیکن تصویر میری ہے۔

A man threatened me saying that if I report him to the police he will harm me and my children. I am very scared and do not know what to do.
میرے سابق ملازم نے مجھے دھمکی دی کہ اگر میں نے اسے نوکری سے نہیں نکالا تو وہ میرے گھر والوں کو نقصان پہنچائے گا۔
A man at my workplace keeps making vulgar comments about my appearance and once touched me inappropriately. I feel uncomfortable and scared coming to work.

My manager at work keeps asking me to meet him alone after hours and hints that my job depends on it. I tried to report it internally but nothing happened.
My company refused to investigate my harassment complaint against a senior employee. How can I escalate this to the harassment ombudsperson?

I live in Punjab and need to leave my home because my husband is violent. Can the court order me to stay in the house or move him out? Is there a shelter I can go to?
My husband threatens to hurt me every day. I am in Punjab and I need an emergency court order to stop him from coming near me right away.
My in-laws are demanding dowry and harassing me and my family for not bringing enough items. What law protects me against dowry demands?
My husband took my children and refuses to let me see them. I want to know my custody rights and how to get a court order to see my children.
My landlord has thrown me out of the rented house without any notice and kept my belongings. What are my rights as a tenant?
